description: Node /var is above 80% - kubelet starts garbage-collecting images at 85% and evicting pods near 90% (etcd, containerd and logs live here)

spec.name: A
spec.query: sum by ("k8s.node.name", mountpoint) ({"system.filesystem.usage", "k8s.node.name"!="ocifree", state="used", mountpoint="/var"}) / (sum by ("k8s.node.name", mountpoint) ({"system.filesystem.usage", "k8s.node.name"!="ocifree", state="used", mountpoint="/var"}) + sum by ("k8s.node.name", mountpoint) ({"system.filesystem.usage", "k8s.node.name"!="ocifree", state="free", mountpoint="/var"})) * 100
